For founders

Submit your deck.

Building in fintech, blockchain or AI? We read every submission, and if there's a fit, we'll reply within 10 business days.

What we look for

  • Domain depthFounders with deep knowledge of their market, who ship quickly and learn faster.
  • Proof of demandA real problem, with evidence that people want it solved: users, revenue, pilots or letters of intent.
  • Durable economicsA business model, and a token model if there is one, that works without relying on the token price.
  • Regulatory maturityRegulation taken seriously from day one, especially in payments, lending and tokenized assets.
  • Essential technologyFintech, blockchain or AI that is essential to the product, not decoration.

What happens next

  1. 01We read your deck
    Every submission is read by our team.
  2. 02We reply if there's a fit
    Within 10 business days, to set up a first call.
  3. 03We go deeper together
    Product, market, team, and how we can help: investment, incubation or both.

We don't sign NDAs at first review, so please share only what you're comfortable sending.
